# AI Use Case Proposal for RetailCo

## Industry and Company Overview
- **Industry**: Retail
- **Company**: RetailCo
- **Focus Areas**: operations, customer experience
- **Industry Trends**: ...

## Proposed Use Cases
### Personalized Product Recommendations
- **Description**: Use ML to analyze customer purchase history and preferences to recommend products, increasing sales and customer satisfaction.
- **Technologies**: Recommendation Systems, ML, Customer Segmentation
- **Reference**: McKinsey: AI in Retail Personalization
- **Resources**:
  - [Predefined](Devanagari-Ecommerce-Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/kshitizgajurel/Devanagari-Ecommerce-Dataset)
  - [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/vijayuv/onlineretail)
  - [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/datasets/kshitizgajurel/Devanagari-Ecommerce-Dataset)
  - [GitHub](https://github.com/databricks/Spark-The-Definitive-Guide/tree/master/data/retail-data)
### Inventory Optimization
- **Description**: Leverage AI to predict demand and optimize stock levels, reducing overstock and stockouts.
- **Technologies**: Time Series Forecasting, ML, GenAI for reporting
- **Reference**: Deloitte: AI in Retail Supply Chain
- **Resources**:
  - [Predefined](Devanagari-Ecommerce-Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/kshitizgajurel/Devanagari-Ecommerce-Dataset)
  - [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/vijayuv/onlineretail)
  - [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/datasets/kshitizgajurel/Devanagari-Ecommerce-Dataset)
  - [GitHub](https://github.com/databricks/Spark-The-Definitive-Guide/tree/master/data/retail-data)
